paper.title: A multi-adjuvant personal neoantigen vaccine generates potent immunity in melanoma
paper.authors: Blass, Keskin, Ott, Wu et al.
paper.source_note: Aggregates derived from Cell supplemental Data S1–S5 (de-identified patient IDs P101–P111). Not clinical care data.

checks.claim: All fully vaccinated patients with bulk TCR data show post-vaccine expanded clonotypes
checks.paperHint: Vaccination induced circulating TCR clonotypes distinct from PD-1 inhibition

checks.claim: Most IMP-expanded TCRβ clones are post-vaccine category (cohort mean > 75%)
checks.paperHint: Neoantigen vaccination reshapes distinct TCR repertoires; IMP-expanded clones enriched post-vaccine

checks.claim: Reactive tumor-associated TCRs are predominantly post-vaccine type
checks.paperHint: TCR reconstruction and antigen screening reveals vaccine-specific TIL post vaccine

checks.claim: Mutation tables cover enrolled patient IDs P101–P111
checks.paperHint: Data S1 related to Figure 1 / vaccine generation

limitations: ELISpot / % IMP immunogenicity figures are not in Data S1–S5 and cannot be rechecked here.
Single-arm, small n; exploratory ipi-dose contrasts are descriptive only.
S1 coding counts are broader than the paper’s ‘high-quality coding mutations’ filter.
